[SWS_PHM_01347] Switch Elementary Supervision Status from kOK to kFAILED
⌈
If Elementary Supervision Status is kOK AND the corresponding
supervision is Alive Supervision AND a temporary failure is detected, i.e. the
counter for failed Alive Supervision reference cycles is greater than zero but does not
exceed failure tolerance failedReferenceCyclesTolerance, THEN the Plat-
form Health Management shall change the Elementary Supervision Sta-
tus to kFAILED.
⌋
